---
title: "Load AB-Bind database"
format: html
engine: knitr
---

## Introduction

This document downloads the AB-Bind database into `_raw/`.
The dataset contains 32 antibody-antigen complex structures, the
experimental binding measurements (`AB-Bind_experimental_data.csv`)
and computational binding energy estimates (`ABbind_compt_data.zip`).

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library("tidyverse")
library("curl")
library("here")
```

## Download the data

```{r}
#| label: download-data
# Download the repository as a zip from GitHub into a temp file
repo_zip_url <- str_c(
  "https://codeload.github.com/sarahsirin/AB-Bind-Database/",
  "zip/refs/heads/master"
)
tmp_zip <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
curl_download(url = repo_zip_url, destfile = tmp_zip)

# Unpack the zip in a temp dir
tmp_dir <- tempfile()
dir.create(tmp_dir)
unzip(tmp_zip, exdir = tmp_dir)
repo_dir <- setdiff(
  list.dirs(tmp_dir, recursive = FALSE),
  file.path(tmp_dir, "__MACOSX")
)

# Copy the repository files into _raw/ and unzip the computational data
raw_dir <- here("_raw")
dir.create(raw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
file.copy(
  list.files(repo_dir, full.names = TRUE),
  raw_dir,
  overwrite = TRUE
)
unzip(here("_raw", "ABbind_compt_data.zip"), exdir = raw_dir)

# The zip carries macOS metadata folders, drop those
unlink(file.path(raw_dir, "__MACOSX"), recursive = TRUE)

# Overview of data in _raw/
tibble(file = list.files(raw_dir, recursive = TRUE))
```

## Experimental binding data

Each mutation (possibly multiple positions changed) has a row with the measured
binding free energy change `ddG(kcal/mol)` plus pdb entry and assay metadata

```{r}
#| label: experimental-data
ab_bind <- read_csv(
  here("_raw", "AB-Bind_experimental_data.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

glimpse(ab_bind)
slice_head(ab_bind, n = 6)
```

## Computational binding data

The unpacked zip holds one `.dat` file per method, semicolon-delimited
with the columns `pdb`, `mutation`, `expt` and `comp`

```{r}
#| label: computational-data
# Read all .dat files
compt_files <- list.files(
  here("_raw", "ABbind_compt_data"),
  pattern = "\\.dat$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

compt_data <- compt_files |>
  set_names(~ str_remove(basename(.x), "\\.dat$")) |>
  map_dfr(
    ~ read_delim(
      .x,
      delim = ";",
      comment = "#",
      trim_ws = TRUE,
      col_names = c("pdb", "mutation", "expt", "comp"),
      col_types = cols(
        pdb = col_character(),
        mutation = col_character(),
        expt = col_double(),
        comp = col_double()
      ),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ),
    .id = "method"
  )

glimpse(compt_data)
count(compt_data, method)
slice_head(compt_data, n = 6)
```
